$comment: Every site in the vitest sources that can skip a test, and why. `scripts/run-vitest.mjs` finds the sites itself (a TypeScript AST scan for runIf/skipIf/skip/todo on it/test/describe, a test context's skip(), and a { skip } or { todo } option) and fails on a site that is not listed here, an entry whose site no longer exists, and, on a full run, a count that moved. `count` is held to two sources besides the run: the skipped tests the reporter attributes to the site, and, where `capability` is set, that CAPABILITY line's population minus declared. `names` is held to the skipped tests' titles. A site is keyed by its file and its source text, not its line, so an edit above it does not stale the entry.

sites.condition: the component's props type declares `keepMounted` (src/test/capabilities.global.ts reads it from the type)
sites.reason: A component with no `keepMounted` prop has no mounted-while-closed state to render on the server; passing the prop would test an unknown attribute, not SSR.
sites.pinned: ssr.contract's 'renders to string with default props' runs for all 38; 'ran the gated tests for every component whose type declares the prop' (expectRanAsDeclared) requires exactly the 12 declaring components to have run it.

sites.condition: the component's props type declares `open` (src/test/capabilities.global.ts reads it from the type)
sites.reason: A component with no `open` prop has no open state to render on the server.
sites.pinned: ssr.contract's 'renders to string with default props' runs for all 38; expectRanAsDeclared requires exactly the 10 declaring components to have run it.

sites.condition: the component declares no motion in its DEFAULT_* constants and its motion-allowed render emits none, in classes or in an inline `style`
sites.reason: ResizablePanel, Stepper and Tooltip have no motion utility anywhere in their sources and render none with motion allowed, so there is no motion to require.
sites.pinned: 'stops animating when the user asks it to' runs for all three and fails on any motion under reduced motion; if one starts to animate with motion allowed it leaves this set and `names` fails the run.

sites.reason: RadioButton/RadioButton, the group's item, takes no `unstyled` prop: it reads the group's through context (RadioButton.tsx passes `unstyled` into the group context).
sites.pinned: The RadioButton group's own 'composes with unstyled rather than fighting it' renders its items under `unstyled`; expectRanAsDeclared requires exactly the 37 declaring components to have run it.
